causal_clock.daily_reference: BTCUSDT final available 5-minute close of each completed UTC calendar day
causal_clock.entry: first 5-minute open strictly after the completed signal hour
causal_clock.regime_threshold: linear-interpolation Q90 of the preceding 756 available RV20 observations with timestamps strictly before t
causal_clock.rv20: sqrt(365*mean(r_d^2)) using exactly calendar-day returns t-20 through t-1
causal_clock.warmup: inactive until 20 returns and 756 prior finite RV20 observations

contamination.claim: contamination-aware discovery; no pristine OOS claim

features.hour_range: log(max high / min low) of completed UTC hour
features.hour_return: log(last close / first open) of completed UTC hour
features.oi_change_6h: log(last completed-hour OI / OI six completed hours earlier)
features.threshold_clock: all feature quantiles use the preceding 2160 finite completed-hour observations, shifted one hour; linear interpolation

frozen_grid.side_rule: down shock requires taker_fraction <= cap and enters long; up shock requires taker_fraction >= 1-cap and enters short; both require OI change <= rolling quantile and range >= rolling quantile

mechanism: In a causally known extreme-volatility regime, a completed one-hour price shock accompanied by open-interest contraction and same-direction taker capitulation identifies forced-position clearing; enter the opposite direction at the next 5-minute open.

path_accounting.barrier_order: same-BTC 5m bar: adverse barrier before favorable barrier when both touched; gap entry and exit charged
path_accounting.cagr: full calendar including all idle time
path_accounting.funding: exact realized funding debit/credit while open
path_accounting.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM plus intratrade favorable-before-adverse envelope

persistent_long_vol_control.definition: long BTC at identical candidate gross from first 5m open of every active RV20 day to that day final 5m close, flat otherwise, same costs and strict accounting
persistent_long_vol_control.gate: candidate residual log return must be positive in train, 2024 confirmation, each future window, and combined future; persistent-long-vol beta alone cannot pass

selection.future: single frozen top1/weight only; no rerank, repair, rank2, or threshold change
selection.leverage_selection: after structural top1, choose highest pre-2024 CAGR subject to strict MDD<=15%, CAGR/MDD>=3, and positive 10bp stress; no future repair
selection.weight_selection: 2024 only; maximize same-gross CAGR/MDD improvement subject to no strict-MDD worsening and max exact-entry Jaccard <=0.15 versus every Gross9 sleeve
